categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Yunyong Electronics and Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on industrial internet and industrial information security products, including research, design, production, and sales. Its main product lines include industrial information security products, industrial IoT products, intelligent archive cabinets, and control systems, primarily serving the power, energy, finance, transportation, and military sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages embedded technology platforms based on RISC architectures (PowerPC, ARM, MIPS, LoongArch) combined with Linux operating systems. Core technologies include trusted computing, cryptographic algorithms, zero-trust security architecture, industrial communication protocol conversion, microgrid energy management, and FPGA-accelerated firewall engines. Production follows a 'sales-driven production with moderate inventory' model, with in-house hardware and software development, SMT assembly, testing, and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are industrial internet technology service providers and equipment suppliers who integrate and resell to end-users in power, energy, finance, transportation, and government sectors. Major clients include State Grid Corporation, Southern Power Grid, and well-known power industry companies such as Guodian Nari and XJ Electric. The company also serves emerging markets in new energy, digital archives, and information technology innovation (Xinchuang).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with significant revenue contributions from the East China and North China regions. It has deployed solutions across multiple provinces including Gansu, Hebei, Ningxia, Henan, and Xinjiang. Sales and service centers are established in cities such as Taizhou, Beijing, Zhengzhou, Nanjing, Zhangshu, and Chengdu.
categories.supply_chain_position: Yunyong Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the industrial information security supply chain, focusing on product development, manufacturing, and direct sales of embedded hardware and software solutions. It procures core components like chips and modules from upstream suppliers and delivers integrated products to downstream system integrators and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in embedded platforms, trusted computing, cryptography, zero-trust security, microgrid energy management, and industrial IoT. It actively develops products for new power systems, energy storage, digital archives, and Xinchuang (information technology innovation) sectors. Strategic collaborations with domestic chip manufacturers (Loongson, Phytium) and OS providers (Kylin) support its innovation. The company also emphasizes improving product-to-market efficiency and expanding its cloud-edge-end collaborative platform.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated hardware and software products, including customized project-based development. Sales are mainly conducted via bidding and commercial negotiations with industrial internet service providers and equipment manufacturers, who then resell to end users. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing models.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Yunyong Technology is positioned as a key domestic supplier in the industrial information security sector, especially in power industry applications. It competes with other Chinese industrial internet and security firms, leveraging its embedded technology platform and strategic partnerships. The company has established a strong brand and customer base in the power sector, with recognized products in network security gateways, encryption devices, and energy management systems.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 296.98 million, a 5.18% increase year-over-year, but recorded a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 35.09 million. R&D expenses accounted for 22.29% of revenue. Total assets were about RMB 1.02 billion with equity of RMB 911.96 million. The company has experienced stable revenue growth but faces profitability challenges due to increased R&D and organizational costs.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Yunyong Technology emphasizes its advanced embedded technology platform supporting multiple domestic CPU architectures and secure Linux systems, enabling high reliability and security in industrial environments. Its products integrate trusted computing, zero-trust security, and cryptographic technologies tailored for industrial internet and power system applications. The company differentiates through deep customization capabilities, strong R&D, strategic partnerships with domestic chip and OS providers, and comprehensive product lines covering industrial security, energy management, and digital archives.
